Creation is limited to 10 requests per minute and replay can start another run.

functions.name: disable-pull-request-automation
functions.description: Prevent future CI/CD check-suite processing for the pull request associated with an agent run and stop all current agents for that PR. Does not delete or close the PR.

agentRunId.description: Run used by Codegen to identify the associated pull request.

beforeCardOrderId.description: Opaque Kanban key of the card that should come before this run in CANCELLED; omit for provider placement.

FunctionInput_codegen_disablepullrequest.description: Identify the pull request through its organization and agent run, with optional Kanban placement.

acknowledged.description: Codegen accepted the disable request; not a claim that every agent has already terminated.

FunctionOutput_codegen_disablepullreques.description: Acknowledgement that Codegen accepted the PR-wide automation disable request.

tags.instructions: Use a run ID from `list-agent-runs` or `get-agent-run` that belongs to the PR. This affects the whole PR, not just that run: future check events are blocked and current related agents are stopped. `enable-pull-request-automation` allows future processing again but does not promise to restart stopped work. Optional card-order keys are only needed for Kanban placement.

functions.name: enable-pull-request-automation
functions.description: Remove the automation ban from the PR associated with an agent run so future CI/CD check-suite events can be processed.

agentRunId.description: Run used to identify the PR whose ban is removed.

FunctionInput_codegen_enablepullrequesta.description: Identify the PR through its organization and agent run, with optional Kanban placement keys.

acknowledged.description: Codegen accepted the unban request; no agent restart or future successful processing is implied.

tags.instructions: Use the organization and run ID identifying the PR, available from `get-agent-run` or `list-agent-runs`. This reverses the future-event block imposed by `disable-pull-request-automation`; it does not promise to resume previously stopped agents. Optional Kanban order keys preserve the provider's placement choices.
